description.value:
This powerful, semiautomatic precision rifle was used by both sides in the Metal Wars. Designed for military use, the SOR-22 won't offer any bells or whistles, much less flashy style or user-friendly design. This awkwardly angular, heavy rifle is built for fucking shit up – and to do so, you're going to need a good endoskeleton and muscle weave. But it more than makes up for any inconvenience with its sheer firepower and reliability. The SOR-22 is rare on the streets of Night City – and it always spells trouble.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Scout Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: NoSlots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load Non-Basic Ammunition. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (7d6). Requires BODY 10+ or being Mounted to not inflict the Torn Muscle Critical Injury when fired.

Range: Scout Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
